comparison: V_hat(pi_18dim) - V_hat(pi_12dim) on Track B test episodes
power_note: Held out 8 episodes / 205 transitions. UNDERPOWERED: fewer than 10 held-out episodes, so the bootstrap CI understates the true uncertainty and NO significance is claimed. NESTED comparison: the 18-dim arm was warm-started from policy_track_a.pt (inheriting a Q-function fitted on 694383 transitions) and fine-tuned on 636, with the waveform dims initialised to zero influence. Both arms therefore rest on the same base fit and the same reward, so ΔV̂ reflects the 6 extra state dimensions. It remains an on-policy greedy-value point estimate, not an FQE. See SYSTEM_SUMMARY §4, §14.
